situation: A new parameter table lists the setting the old claim named but leaves out the tuning advice the document still gives.

candidates.claim: Kestrel's `WorkerConfig` takes `poll_interval` (default 5 seconds), `lease_timeout` (default 60 seconds) and `max_workers` (maximum concurrent workers, default 8).

evidence.excerpt:
| Option | Meaning | Default |
| poll_interval | Seconds between queue polls | 5 |
| lease_timeout | Seconds a worker holds a job before it is released | 60 |
| max_workers | Maximum concurrent workers | 8 |

incumbents.claim: The number of concurrent Kestrel workers is set by `max_workers` (default 8). Lower it to reduce lock contention on the queue database; raise it for throughput when many short jobs are queued.
